title: GCM_PINNs: code, trained weights, and evaluation results of a physics-informed neural network surrogate model for a general circulation model
description: Code, trained weights, and evaluation results for the manuscript "Development and evaluation of a physics-informed neural network surrogate model for a general circulation model" by K. Fukazawa and Y. Miyoshi (submitted to Earth, Planets and Space). The package contains the training and evaluation code of the autoregressive PINN surrogate of a T42, 150-level GCM that contains the region from the ground surface to the exobase, 63 trained checkpoints (21 configurations with three random seeds each), the evaluation results of all runs, the statistical baselines, and the scripts for the tables and figures of the paper. Version 2.x replaces version 1.x: the vertical velocity of the GCM output is treated as a pressure vertical velocity in the physics residual and in the kinematic boundary condition, and all configurations were retrained. Version 2.1.0 adds the experiments on the amount of training (M5-4E, M5-8E, and M5-P0-8E; nine runs); the code for training and evaluation and the checkpoints and results of version 2.0.0 are unchanged. The GCM output used for training is available from the authors upon reasonable request.
